rnc.note: RNC MCP server — read-only, tenant-scoped tools for zooming into a legacy module (getModuleRules, getModuleDataModel, getUirModule). Needs RNC_TOKEN in the environment: run /rnc-login once, then `export RNC_TOKEN=$(npx -y @skalena/rnc mcp token)` in your shell profile. Override the host with RNC_BASE_URL.
